summary: Executed backend + frontend validation for Revenues module, role permissions, search modal, edit/delete, print behavior, and cleanup. Core requested revenue flows passed on public URL; auth-hardening playbook checks found security gaps.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout after 5 failed logins; valid login still succeeds immediately.
Auth token is returned in JSON body/localStorage flow only; app does not issue dedicated HttpOnly auth cookie.

minor.issue: backend/.env uses CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True instead of explicit origins.
ensure_default_admin returns early when admin exists, so changed ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD is not reconciled into existing admin account.

action_items: Implement rate-limit/lockout policy for /api/auth/login after repeated failed attempts.
Move auth session to secure HttpOnly cookie flow (or add cookie-based option) instead of token-only localStorage flow.
Set explicit allowed origins in backend/.env for CORS when credentials are enabled.
Make admin seeding idempotent to update existing admin password hash when ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD changes (controlled/safe path).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py exceeds 1400 LOC monolith threshold, increasing regression risk and review complexity.
Security posture does not meet auth playbook expectations (lockout + cookie session + strict CORS origin list).

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 pytest in this iteration across 2 files)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (core requested revenues flows passed; one intermediate automation run failed due dialog wait strategy, final run passed)

test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used admin/Admin@123; created temporary TEST_* users and cleaned them.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_* users and temporary revenue records were created during UI/API tests and cleaned via /app/backend/tests/test_iteration15_cleanup_test_records.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://interest-calculator-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Revenues module features are functionally working (create/search/edit/delete, role-based UI visibility, and print CSS hiding form/tools). Cleanup test removed TEST_* users and TEST revenues. Remaining work is primarily auth hardening and config security alignment.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (No lockout): /api/auth/login performs direct password verification and returns 401 on failure but does not persist failed-attempt counters or lockout timestamps. Repro: submit wrong password 5 times, then correct password succeeds immediately. Mitigation: persist per-user/IP failed attempts, apply timed lockout and/or exponential backoff. RCA-2 (No HttpOnly app auth cookie): backend returns token in response body; frontend stores in localStorage (AuthContext/api.js). No dedicated app Set-Cookie auth session is issued by backend routes. Mitigation: server-set HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite cookies and CSRF strategy. RCA-3 (CORS): backend/.env currently CORS_ORIGINS='*' while allow_credentials=True; this is weaker than explicit-origin policy expected in playbook.
